verdict.rationale: Bun's package manager is CLI-first, with no separate GUI. Every documented capability is exposed through scriptable commands an agent can drive, so parity between interfaces is inherent: install, add, remove, update, dedupe, prune, audit/fix, publish, pack, outdated, why, info, link, workspace filtering and frozen lockfiles. The only interactive mode (`bun update --interactive`) has non-interactive equivalents. Missing for 10: any programmatic or library API beyond the CLI (OpenAPI probes all 404), evidence of machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output for agents, and independent corroboration of fully scripted use.
